name: interp2
expr: r1 = interp2([1 2], [1; 2], X, 1.5, 1.5); cA = interp2(V, 2.5, 2.5, 'cubic'); cB = interp2(V, 1.3, 3.7, 'cubic'); cN = interp2(V, 2, 3, 'cubic'); cQ = interp2(GX, GY, W, 2.5, 2.5, 'cubic');
comment: Sig: r = interp2(...[,method]). Default bilinear; 'cubic' = Keys bicubic convolution (a=-0.5) on a uniform grid, with MATLAB's one-cell edge padding (3*v1-3*v2+v3) so near-boundary queries match. cA interior, cB near-boundary (exercises padding), cN on a grid node (exact), cQ X,Y,V form.
